verdict.rationale: Azure exposes resource management through several programmatic surfaces: the cross-platform Azure CLI, REST APIs with client libraries for most services, declarative ARM/Bicep templates, Terraform with resource export, and the Cost Management APIs. A hands-on user also reports that "almost everything can be done via command line." missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that API coverage matches the portal, published OpenAPI specs (probes of candidate paths returned 404), and independent confirmation that no portal-only gaps exist (the client-library claim covers only "most" services).
